subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased, or replace/adopt it with a maintainer-owned narrow fix?
rationale: The bug boundary is clear, but the only open implementation candidate is a conflicting cross-repository PR with `maintainerCanModify: false`, so automation should not open a duplicate fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace or Adopt the Fork PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository fix, credit the source work, and close the fork PR after a replacement exists.

options.title: Ask Contributor to Rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired to the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase and enable maintainer edits if possible.

options.title: Wait Without New Work
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open until the contributor updates it, accepting that the known rendering bug remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Replace or Adopt the Fork PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository fix, credit the source work, and close the fork PR after a replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original sanitizer boundary and authored the TUI leading-stripper path, making them the strongest routing candidate for the adoption-or-replacement choice.
